# anecdotes_framework_folders (Data Source)

Lists all framework folders in the Anecdotes account, with optional name filtering.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anecdotes_framework_folders" "all" {}

output "folder_count" {
  value = data.anecdotes_framework_folders.all.total_count
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name_contains` (String) Filter folders whose name contains this substring (case-insensitive).

### Read-Only

- `folders` (Attributes List) List of framework folders. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--folders))
- `total_count` (Number) Total number of folders matching the filters.

<a id="nestedatt--folders"></a>
### Nested Schema for `folders`

Read-Only:

- `folder_id` (String) The unique identifier of the folder.
- `frameworks_list` (List of String) List of framework IDs in this folder.
- `name` (String) The name of the folder.
